title: clarkia amoena f. concolor
intro: Clarkia amoena f. concolor, commonly known as the evening primrose or evening star, is a flowering plant species in the evening primrose family. The plant is known for its delicate, white, and fragrant flowers, which bloom in the evening and close with the dawn. The health benefits of Clarkia amoena f. concolor include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality due to its sedative and antispasmodic properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
